title: Business Consultant
description:
About Centric Software:

Centric Software® is a global leader, providing an innovative and AI-enabled product-concept-to-commercialization platform for retailers, brands and manufacturers of all sizes. We equip retail, fashion, luxury, footwear, outdoor, home and consumer goods brands with pioneering best-of-breed solutions to plan, design, develop, source, comply, buy, make, price, allocate, sell and replenish products. Our technology powers brands to streamline processes, drive efficiency and operate with confidence in an ever-changing market.

Our story is one of rapid growth, bold ideas and extraordinary opportunities. We’re here to challenge the status quo—and we’re looking for brilliant people who want to do the same. No matter where you are in the world, this is your chance to be part of something exceptional.

Job Summary:

The Business Consultant will be responsible for delivering Centric 8 Agile deployment projects on-time, per schedule per responsible technical and business goals of the company (e.g. out-of-the-box – OOTB configurations, customer business process mapping, and best practice advocacy).

You will provide technical leadership and support to pre-sales and implementation teams, helping design and deliver Centric 8 solutions for clients across the formulated products sector.

Manage deployment projects per Centric’s Agile deployment methodology, delivering customer solution model per out-of-the-box Centric 8 (PLM) use cases and configuration points and Centric’s Agile processes. Conduct customer business process analysis, information modeling, mapping to Centric 8 configurations and interface control definitions with related systems to be integrated, data and process conversion from legacy PDM systems, provide customer guidance on process-system alignment practices, desk top procedures, process-system validation and training and on-going customer care.

Acquire and disseminate FMCG domain and system integration best practices and provide customer scenario details to guide product development, QA, Customer Support groups as needed.

Responsibilities:

  • Coordinate and collaborate with customer implementation team and Centric teams to ensure a successful and referenceable delivery.
  • Analyze customer business process requirements as a basis to propose Centric 8 (OOTB) Solutions.
  • Consult, deploy, tune, configure, optimize and install Centric software stack within customer’s IT environment, with a focus on enterprise high availability and system integration dimensions.
  • Produce written specifications (i.e. UML models, Centric 8 configurations) to capture business process requirements for proposed solutions and configuration activities.
  • Analyze requirements and design solutions to address customer business scenarios within the product scope.
  • Ensure clear understanding of customer’s technology requirements; provide support for Proposal and Project teams, provide technical leadership and vision to win and deliver large-scale, complex solutions.
  • Develop and document Data/Object Model to meet customers’ requirements.
  • Identify, delegate and execute project tasks including installing and configuring software, deployment training, data migration and deployment support.
  • Mentor other consultants during the delivery of Centric Software based solutions.
  • Provide input into future solution functionality, implementation methodology and configuration standards.
  • Ensure that quality software engineering processes and Agile practices are followed.

Qualifications:

  • Experience with involvement in real-world PLM and enterprise system integration deployments in domain
  • Experience with Formulated Products industry best practices and change management considerations
  • Proven project management experience as evidenced by successful project delivery
  • strong and confident Customer Facing / consulting skills.
  • Experience in software installation, IT troubleshooting and optimization – Database (SQL Server, Oracle), Application Server (JBoss), experience with load balancing and clustering environments. Skills in performance tuning and optimization and trouble shooting relative to the software stack web environment.
  • Availability for overnight travel.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits
  • A multifaceted job with a high degree of responsibility and a broad spectrum of opportunities
  • Opportunity to work remotely with a dedicated and motivated team
  • A remote work environment built on collaboration, flexibility, and respect
  • Varied and challenging work to help you grow your technical skillset.

Centric Software provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status or genetic information.

Essential Skills & Experience

Strong commercial experience as a Network Engineer.

Hands-on experience with Fortinet / FortiGate environments.

Solid understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching.

Experience troubleshooting complex network issues.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Excellent communication and documentation skills.


Desirable

Experience with FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer.

Experience with Cisco, Aruba or other enterprise networking technologies.

Knowledge of cloud networking, particularly Azure or AWS.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Full-Stack / Cross-Asset Trading Systems
description:
Senior Software Engineer - Full-Stack / Cross-Asset Trading Systems Location London Business Area Engineering and CTO Ref # 10052703

Description & Requirements

Join the Pioneers of Trading Technology:
Imagine working on a team that's revolutionising the way financial markets operate, with trillions of dollars traded on your systems every day.
The Cross-Asset Trading System (CATS) Blotter is a powerful platform that provides a consistent base for Bloomberg trading applications. We provide infrastructure, frameworks and the frontend used at the core of some of the most demanding trading applications at Bloomberg.
You’ll be building a scalable, reliable, high volume platform, and solving some of the toughest problems in software with industry experts.


What we do


We design and build a reusable, business-agnostic platform that takes care of the fundamental use cases common to many trading workflows. In CATS, performance is critical and extensible architectural design is key so, by joining our team, you’ll face interesting technical challenges alongside your strong team of colleagues who value quality above all.

As a Senior Software Engineer in CATS, you'll be part of a full-stack platform team that's pushing the boundaries of what's possible with TypeScript, Redux and React, as well as our Data Publishing Pipelines and backend services and getting the most out of the Bloomberg Terminal infrastructure. Our mission is to super-charge and unify the trading system worlds to reimagine how powerful trading systems are built at Bloomberg.

Who we are


We are a friendly, collaborative team who care about what we do and working to improve ourselves and our systems every day. The onboarding experience is a priority for us: we have extensive onboarding documentation and videos, and you will be assigned a dedicated mentor who will support you from day one. We are a global team, with members in both London and New York.

Be part of something big

Impact


  • Lead critical projects that shape the future of trading technology in over 15 trading applications and >50k high value clients.
  • Expand your reach by collaborating with product managers and engineering teams across Bloomberg who use or onboard onto the platform, while gaining expertise of the trading ecosystem.
  • Have a say in the software architecture and future direction of both CATS and the trading systems we support.

Technical challenges


  • Use and expand your software architecture skills: you’ll design and build re-usable, business-agnostic software.
  • Write code that will stand the test of time and inform top decision makers. These complex systems showcase and interact with large volumes of data at high speed.
  • Develop and deploy both frontend and backend systems with challenges ranging from complex state management, client-side Terminal integration, and data subscription pipelines that support numerous trading instruments.

Collaborative team culture


  • We love to learn together. We encourage collaboration, pair programming, and working on projects and technical designs as a team.
  • We encourage involvement in Guilds, meetups, training, communities, and exploring all the learning opportunities that Bloomberg provides.
  • We support side projects -- decide what matters to you and make a difference.
  • Want to lead projects? We have many opportunities to take on a challenge and carve out a niche for yourself.

We’ll trust you to


  • Write rock-solid code across the stack, including occasional inner-source contributions to enhance the infrastructure we use, or to support our platform users.
  • Take pride in your work and show ownership over its outcomes and consequences.
  • Work with your colleagues within the team, in other Engineering teams and in Product. You will flesh out requirements, design and build new features and release them to users while keeping the system as stable as ever.
  • Drive the incorporation of new technologies and improve development practices.
  • Mentor others and encourage knowledge sharing in order to drive the growth of the team.

You’ll need to have


  • 3+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Experience in modern programming languages with the desire to become a JavaScript/TypeScript expert.
  • Prior experience in JS/TS is not required but would be a plus.
A strong software engineering mindset, especially in the quality and correctness of your work.Good communication skills and the ability to explain technical problems to non-technical stakeholders.A desire to learn, understand and scale existing systems, sharing knowledge along the way.
We'd love to see

  • Experience developing platforms, APIs, or plugin architectures
  • Familiarity with Redux or React
  • Experience leading large projects with multiple stakeholders
  • Experience triaging and debugging production problems
  • Experience mentoring junior engineers





If indicated, please note that years of experience are a guide; we will consider applications from all candidates who can demonstrate the skills necessary for the role. Discover what makes Bloomberg unique - watch our podcast series for an inside look at our culture, values, and the people behind our success.

title: CHARGE RN II - Observations (CDU)
description:
Fulltime / Night Shift

At Houston Methodist, the Charge Nurse position is a licensed professional Registered Nurse (RN) who, as an experienced clinician, functions at the Competent to Proficient stage of Benner's model of clinical practice. This position creates an environment for the management and delivery of safe patient care. In addition to fulfilling the duties and responsibilities of a clinical nurse, the Charge Nurse position is a role model and coach to department personnel and assists in developing their skills and knowledge. This position provides nursing care to a diverse patient population. Besides conducting nursing assessments, assisting with exams and treatment and maintenance of medical records, this position assists in coaching and mentoring department staff in areas of clinical and professional practice. Role modeling compassionate communication with physicians and the interprofessional health care team, the Charge Nurse assumes leadership responsibilities with high-level contributions at the bedside, unit, service line, and across the institution. Responsibilities for this position may include but are not limited to leading unit and shared governance activities, assessing unit needs related to practice and improvement opportunities, serving as a clinical resource for both unit and hospital staff and coordinating unit and hospital-wide education in partnership with management.

FLSA STATUS
Non-exempt

QUALIFICATIONS

EDUCATION
  • Graduate of education program approved by the credentialing body for the required credential(s) indicated below in the Certifications, Licenses and Registrations section

EXPERIENCE
  • Twenty four months of clinical nursing experience with demonstration of progressive leadership skills

LICENSES AND CERTIFICATIONS
Required
  • RN - Registered Nurse - Texas State Licensure - Texas Board of Nursing_PSV Compact Licensure – Must obtain permanent Texas license within 60 days (if establishing Texas residency) and
  • BLS - Basic Life Support or Instructor (AHA) - American Heart Association
Preferred
  • Magnet - ANCC Recognized Certification
  • ACLS - Advanced Cardiac Life Support or Instructor (AHA) within 4 months
  • NIHSTROKE - National Institute of Health Stroke Scale Certification (AHA) within 4 months
  • NVCRISIS - Nonviolent Crisis Intervention or Instructor (CPI)

KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES
  • Demonstrates the skills and competencies necessary to safely perform the assigned job, determined through ongoing skills, competency assessments, and performance evaluations
  • Sufficient proficiency in speaking, reading, and writing the English language necessary to perform the essential functions of this job, especially with regard to activities impacting patient or employee safety or security
  • Ability to effectively communicate with patients, physicians, family members and co-workers in a manner consistent with a customer service focus and application of positive language principles
  • Strong assessment, organizational and problem solving skills as evidenced by capacity to prioritize multiple tasks and role components
  • Ability to function independently and exercise judgment in interactions with physicians, interprofessional healthcare team and patients and their families
  • Uses critical thinking skills and clinical judgment to work autonomously as defined by the Nurse Practice Act
  • Demonstrates proficient time management skills
  • Demonstrates highly developed assessment skills; contributes to policies, procedure and protocols
  • Has knowledge of Nursing Unit’s Dashboard and Hospital Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems (HCAHPS) scores
  • Demonstrates expertise in operating the electronic medical record
  • Maintains level of professional contributions as defined in Clinical Career Path program guide


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

PEOPLE ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • Fosters staff engagement by demonstrating active listening, requesting and acknowledging feedback, making equitable decisions, providing rationale when appropriate, and supporting organizational goals. Anticipates the needs of the staff members and proactively offers assistance. Role models inter-professional communication, which includes active listening and teaching, and assists with staff stress management as needed. Improves departmental scores for turnover/retention on unit-based scorecard.
  • Role models fair and consistent leadership skills for effective team dynamics and team building strategies through problem solving, coaching, and developing staff. Coaches staff to use efficient and effective communication to establish and maintain a team environment, and to include the patient and family as a part of the team regarding their plan of care. Provides input into staff performance reviews, as appropriate.
  • Functions as a mentor and resource to unit staff, provides oversight for students/new employee/preceptorships. Identifies levels of organizational conflict and applies tools to effectively resolve concerns, complaints or conflict with patients, families, physicians and other inter-professional healthcare team members.

SERVICE ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • Leads the patient and family-centered care standards, as outlined in the Houston Methodist Professional Nursing Practice document. Mentors others regarding specialty populations; audits plan of care. Practices in a manner that is congruent with cultural diversity and inclusion principles.
  • Maintains ongoing interactions with patients, families, and staff on the improvement of patient care through leader rounding. Ensures effective collaboration with other departments regarding patient process issues.
  • Drives department service standards and activities to improve department score for patient satisfaction on unit-based scorecard, through role modeling and fostering accountability.

QUALITY/SAFETY ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • Models the standards of care related to the nursing process, as outlined in the Houston Methodist Professional Nursing Practice document, by actively participating in meeting and improving nurse sensitive quality indicators and patient safety goals. Participates in the creation of a continuous improvement environment by promoting situational awareness, assisting with audits as needed, and using teachable moments.
  • Coordinates nursing care throughout the shift considering patient acuity, staff skill level and safety to ensure that our duty to our patients can be met. Models the standards related to regulatory requirements and professional practice as outlined in the Houston Methodist Professional Nursing Practice document.
  • Facilitates seamless patient flow to/from/through the department, leading the delivery of quality family-centered care throughout the continuum of care. Ensures the patient plan of care is accurate and timely, coaching staff if documentation deficiencies are identified. Works closely with the OAs and bed management regarding timely patient placement. Proactively recognizes, determines a plan of action, and responds to situations, such as Rapid Response/CERTs, and emergency codes.
  • Participates in initiatives to improve quality and safety scores on the unit and hospital scorecards, through peer-to-peer accountability, reporting near misses and identifying solutions by collaborating with the interprofessional team. Role models situational awareness, using teachable moments to improve safety. Assists with audits as needed.

FINANCE ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • Implements department strategies to achieve financial target on unit-based scorecard and mentors others to do the same through timely documentation of care, decreasing length of stay, optimizing efficiency, minimizing incidental overtime, and other areas according to departmental specifications.
  • Attends daily care coordination rounds to facilitate patient progression. Ensures that follow-up has been implemented on any concerns or issues identified by the team. Manages productivity in accordance with staffing grid.
  • Provides input into unit resource utilization including unit capital and operational budget needs. Oversees shift by shift resource utilization through the allocation of staff, supplies and contributions to the patient throughput.

GROWTH/INNOVATION ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • Fosters identification and implementation of innovative solutions for practice changes to improve patient care or unit operations such as reduction of hospital readmissions or other department-specific measures by leading and/or participating in unit projects and shared governance activities. Investigates and incorporates evidence-based practices which are presented to shared governance and leadership. Supports change initiatives and adapts to unexpected changes.
  • Expands individual nursing knowledge and coaches staff to grow in knowledge, abilities, skills, and attitudes. Serves as clinical resource. Develops and disseminates, as appropriate, informational/educational resources and programs designed to improve quality and professional practice.


SUPPLEMENTAL REQUIREMENTS
    WORK ATTIRE
    • Uniform: Yes
    • Scrubs: Yes
    • Business professional: No
    • Other (department approved): No

    ON-CALL*
    *Note that employees may be required to be on-call during emergencies (ie. Disaster, Severe Weather Events, etc) regardless of selection below.
    • On Call* Yes

    TRAVEL**
    **Travel specifications may vary by department**
    • May require travel within the Houston Metropolitan area Yes
    • May require travel outside Houston Metropolitan area No

The growing campus offers access to the most innovative medical and surgical care available, including cardiology and cardiovascular surgery; neurology and neurosurgery; comprehensive cancer care; orthopedics and sports medicine; gastroenterology; bariatrics; childbirth center with level III NICU; emergency care; and advanced imaging.

title: Junior Maintenance Assistant
description:
Vuoi iniziare la tua carriera nel mondo della manutenzione?

Magic Engineering è alla ricerca di un Junior Maintenance Assistant motivato, volenteroso e intraprendente, anche alle prime armi, che abbia voglia di imparare, mettersi in gioco e contribuire alla cura e al buon funzionamento degli spazi e dell’infrastruttura aziendale di una realtà internazionale in continua crescita.

🚗 Chi siamo

Dall’esperienza di Magicmotorsport, brand riconosciuto a livello internazionale nella meccatronica e nelle performance, nasce Magic Engineering, azienda italiana che sviluppa soluzioni tecnologiche avanzate con un approccio ingegneristico orientato all’innovazione.

Oggi estendiamo questo know-how oltre l’automotive, lavorando su sistemi complessi e tecnologie emergenti, continuando a supportare i professionisti del settore con strumenti innovativi.

📍 Sede: Partinico (PA), Sicilia, HQ


🔍 Descrizione del ruolo

Come Junior Maintenance Assistant affiancherai il nostro Maintenance Manager nelle attività quotidiane di manutenzione, ordinaria e straordinaria, e nella gestione dei fornitori.

Contribuirai all’organizzazione e pianificazione del servizio di manutenzione con l’obiettivo di renderlo sempre più puntuale ed efficiente.


🎯 Attività principali

  • Supportare le attività di piccola e media manutenzione ordinaria dei locali aziendali (riparazioni, pitturazioni, controllo quadri elettrici, sostituzione/rifornimento boccioni d’acqua, pulizia dei sistemi di condizionamento, ecc.);

  • Contribuire alla manutenzione degli spazi esterni aziendali (pulizia e gestione piscina, giardinaggio e gestione dei terreni, dell’impianto di osmosi, dell’impianto di clorazione, ecc.);

  • Supportare il monitoraggio delle attività svolte da fornitori esterni e la gestione dei relativi preventivi;

  • Contribuire alla gestione e al controllo del parco auto aziendale (revisioni, pulizia, livello carburante);

  • Supportare la gestione delle richieste provenienti dagli altri reparti (servizio transfer da/per l’aeroporto, ritiro e consegna pacchi, ecc);

💡 Requisiti tecnici e competenze principali

  • Diploma di scuola superiore;

  • Possesso di patente B in corso di validità;

  • Ottime capacità manuali;

  • Precisione, predisposizione all’ascolto e al lavoro in team;

  • Ottima conoscenza della lingua italiana e conoscenza base della lingua inglese;

Costituirà un plus

  • Breve esperienza in attività di manutenzione;

  • Competenze, anche di base, in ambito edilizio, idraulico e/o muratura;

  • Possesso di attestati per muletto, carrello elevatore, lavori in quota, PLE o spazi confinati;

🎁 Vantaggi e benefit

  • Affiancamento diretto e formazione continua sul campo;

  • L’opportunità di sviluppare competenze tecniche e operative in diversi ambiti della manutenzione;

  • Un ambiente dinamico e internazionale;

  • Colazione, pranzo e snack gratuiti presso la nostra mensa aziendale;

  • Concrete opportunità di crescita professionale;

📝 Offerta di lavoro

  • Offriamo un tirocinio della durata di 6 mesi, con possibilità di inserimento subordinato al raggiungimento degli obiettivi di formazione e crescita previsti;

  • Indennità mensile di stage: 600–800 € lordi, a seconda del percorso formativo, delle competenze tecniche e delle capacità personali del candidato, in conformità con la normativa vigente in materia di stage;


Se hai voglia di imparare, metterti in gioco e crescere professionalmente, non vediamo l’ora di conoscerti.

Candidati ora! 🚀

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Affinity stitches together billions of data points from massive datasets to create a powerful, accurate representation of the world's professional relationship graph. Based on this data, we offer our users the insights and visibility they need to nurture and tap into the opportunities in their team's network.

This role is part of the AI Platform team, which owns the AI services that power Affinity's industry-leading relationship intelligence platform. We extract and retrieve information from billions of structured and unstructured data points to deliver actionable insights to customers.

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will collaborate with data engineers, software engineers, and product managers to shape the future of private capital's leading CRM platform. You will design and build AI systems that efficiently uncover insights from compelling business interaction data – an exciting and unique opportunity within the industry.

This is an applied machine learning position with a strong emphasis on engineering, rather than research. You will play a key role in advancing our ML Engineering capabilities, particularly in information retrieval and eventually recommendation systems.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Own the full ML lifecycle: Take projects from ideation to production, including feature engineering, model selection, deployment, and model observability and evaluation.

  • Translate business needs into ML solutions: Gather product requirements and translate them into robust ML system design requirements.

  • Build recommendation and ranking systems: Architect and launch ranking and recommendation infrastructure from scratch, initially via integrated off-the-shelf models, and evolving to targeted and customized solutions in the long term.

  • Solve complex problems: Work on a variety of information extraction, information storage and information retrieval problems for both structured and unstructured data.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with cross-functional (product, infra, data engineering, and software engineering) teams to build robust, high-scale systems that underlie all of our data processing and ML Operations.

Qualifications

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every qualification. At Affinity, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role, but your past experience doesn’t perfectly align with the qualifications above, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Required:

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering and/or Machine Learning experience in applying machine learning in production.

  • Hands-on experience developing ranking or recommendation systems from scratch, deployed at scale using techniques such as learn-to-rank, explainable recommendations

  • Strong understanding of machine learning techniques, including clustering and decision trees

  • Experience with serving ML models for streaming and batch inference at scale.

  • Experience with vector or graph databases.

  • Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, Scikit-learn, or similar).

  • Track record of building maintainable, testable, and production-grade codebases.

  • Experience with observability tools for online and offline model evaluation, A/B testing, and tracing for AI applications.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with dataset engineering, including data curation, augmentation, and synthesis, to assist ML model improvement.

  • Experience with graph-based recommendation systems, such as graph NN.

  • Experience with packaging, CI/CD and pipeline automation.

title: Pædagog til Ørnevang Børnehus - midt i et stærkt fællesskab og en spændende genopbygning
description:
For at få et bredere ansøgerfelt genopslår vi stillingen. Vi søger en faglig stærk pædagog til vores vuggestue med tiltrædelse snarest muligt.

Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på fuld tid, men vi er åbne for andre ønsker, da det betyder noget for os, at jobbet også passer til dit privatliv. Arbejdstiden ligger i tidsrummet 6.45-16.45 og med et månedligt aftenmøde kl. 17-20.

Om os:
Ørnevang Børnehus er en integreret institution beliggende i Uglevang i Allerød. I november 2025 oplevede vi desværre en brand, som betød, at halvdelen af vores børnehus blev ødelagt. I dag er vores vuggestue derfor midlertidigt genhuset i Lillerød Børnehus – og det har åbnet for nye muligheder, stærke samarbejder og et ekstra fokus på fællesskab og udvikling.

I Lillerød Børnehus hvor vi er genhuset har vi to vuggestue grupper bestående af ca. 22 børn og 7 engagerede voksne, der arbejder tæt sammen på tværs. Vi har vores dagligdag i nyrenoverede, lyse og indbydende lokaler med direkte adgang til en stor og inspirerende legeplads. Derudover råder vi over to mindre legepladser, som giver rige muligheder for varieret leg, bevægelse og udforskning i trygge rammer.

Hos os arbejder vi med en tydelig struktur i hverdagen. Vi har en fast ugestruktur med planlagte aktiviteter, hvor børnene både er inddelt i aldersopdelte grupper og indgår i fællesskaber på tværs. Det giver børnene mulighed for at udvikle sig socialt og øve sig i både små og større fællesskaber.

Selvom vi er midlertidigt placeret i Lillerød Børnehus, lægger vi stor vægt på at bevare vores tilknytning til vores "hjem" i Uglevang. Vi besøger jævnligt vores børnehaveafdeling og vores kolleger der, så sammenhængen og relationerne fortsat styrkes.

Vi prioriterer ture og oplevelser ud af huset højt. Med både store klapvogne og eldrevne ladcykler tager vi gerne på tur til skov, mose, bibliotek eller Allerød midtby. Vores køkken hjælper med madpakker, så vi nemt kan tage afsted og skabe gode oplevelser for børnene i nærmiljøet.

Transportmulighederne er gode – bussen holder lige uden for døren, og Allerød Station kan nås på blot 5 minutter på cykel.

Faglig udvikling og indflydelse på hverdagen
Vores vuggestue er for nylig blevet opnormeret, og vi har fået nye kolleger med på holdet. Derfor bliver du en del af et team i udvikling, hvor der er gode muligheder for at få indflydelse på, hvordan vi tilrettelægger hverdagen, så vi skaber de bedst mulige rammer for børnenes trivsel, læring og udvikling.

Vi er et børnehus med et godt pædagogisk fundament, hvor vi arbejder målrettet med, at børnene trives, udvikler sig, dannes og knytter venskaber. Særligt sproglig og motorisk udvikling, udeliv samt et tæt og tillidsfuldt forældresamarbejde er centrale elementer i vores dagligdag.

Vi tager afsæt i den styrkede pædagogiske læreplan og planlægger vores praksis med udgangspunkt i børnenes perspektiver. Vi arbejder bevidst med læringsmiljøer gennem hele dagen og har et vedvarende fokus på børnenes deltagelsesmuligheder – fordi vi ved, at høj kvalitet i samspillet skaber fundamentet for trivsel, udvikling, læring og dannelse.

Stærkt fokus på tilknytning og faglig kompetenceudvikling
Vi arbejder særligt målrettet med tilknytning, relationer og børns følelsesmæssige udvikling. Som en del af dette er alle dagtilbud i Allerød Kommune aktuelt i gang med et større fagligt kompetenceforløb i samarbejde med Tea Thyrre Sørensen med temaet ”Tilknytning, samspil og selvregulering – med legen som omdrejningspunkt”.

Der er tilknyttet kursus dage for alle medarbejdere – og du vil naturligvis blive en del af dette udviklingsforløb som en integreret del af din ansættelse.

Om dig
Det betyder ikke så meget for os om du er nyuddannet eller om du har meget erfaring, men vi ønsker os en kollega, som:

  • Er fagligt velfunderet og kan sætte ord på sin faglighed
  • Brænder for at skabe kvalitet og sammenhæng i de små børns hverdag
  • Ikke er bange for at gå foran og tage initiativ til at sætte aktiviteter i gang
  • Er nærværende og aktivt deltagende sammen med børnene
  • Formår at se børnenes potentialer og perspektiv i alt hvad vi gør
  • Er god til at samarbejde og parat til at bruge egne kompetencer på tværs af grupper
  • Vægter teamsamarbejde højt, ved at være fleksibel, nysgerrig, lydhør og løsningsorienteret
  • Kan bevare roen i en travl hverdag med mange bolde i luften og høje forventninger
  • Er positiv og har let til smil
  • Er tryg ved at forberede og afholde forældresamtaler og skrive diverse udtalelser på børn.

Derfor skal du vælge os

  • Du får mulighed for at få meget indflydelse på at strukturere en hverdag der giver mening for børnene
  • Du får rig adgang til faglig sparring og udvikling, både med kolleger og pædagogisk leder, på tværs i klyngen og med andre tværfaglige samarbejdspartnere
  • Hvert team har tid til at mødes 2 gange om måneden i ca 2,5 time i alt og tale om blandt andet kommende aktiviteter, pædagogik, læringsmiljøer og sprogindsatser
  • Der er mulighed for faglig sparring med tværprofessionelle samarbejdspartnere en gang om måneden på vores ressource team-møder
  • Mulighed for forberedelsestid
  • Pædagogisk ledelse tæt på medarbejderne med fokus på arbejdsfællesskab og kerneopgave
  • Du får 3 dages kompetenceudviklingsforløb med Tea Thyrre Sørensen.

I Allerød Kommune arbejder vi ud fra vores Børne- og ungepolitik med dertilhørende underliggende børne- og læringssyn.

Allerød Kommune er en arbejdsplads med høj social kapital. Vi vægter tværfagligt samarbejde, kompetence- og jobudvikling og ikke mindst medindflydelse på egen hverdag højt. Det vigtigste for os er vores kerneopgave - at skabe værdi for borgerne.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår vil blive fastsat efter gældende overenskomst for pædagoger.

Er du interesseret?
Du er meget velkommen til at kontakte daglig pædagogisk leder Camilla Jensen på telefonnummer: 21 16 18 24 for at høre nærmere om stillingen og eventuelt få en rundvisning. Du uploader din ansøgning sammen med dit CV og uddannelsesbevis via linket i annoncen senest fredag d. 4/9. Vi forventer at holde ansættelsessamtaler løbende og indhenter referencer og straffe oplysninger forud for endelig ansættelse.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning.

Kommunen har ca. 2.000 medarbejdere, der arbejder ud fra et fælles Leder- og Medarbejdergrundlag, hvor værdier som dialog, samarbejde, respekt og faglighed er hjørnesten. Her kan du læse Allerød Kommunes Leder- og Medarbejdergrundlag.

Organisationen baserer sig på flade strukturer, stor medindflydelse og gode udviklingsmuligheder. Allerød Kommune er en røgfri arbejdsplads med røgfri arbejdstid.

Vi tror på, at mangfoldighed hos vores medarbejdere styrker vores organisation og løsningen af den fælles kerneopgave. Vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede ansøgere til at søge stillingen uanset køn, kønsidentitet, alder, handicap, etnisk baggrund eller seksuel orientering.

Allerød Kommune ligger i hjertet af Nordsjælland i en smuk og varieret natur. Kommunen har tæt på 26.000 indbyggere og byder på et aktivt forenings- og erhvervsliv med gode idræts- og fritidsmuligheder.

Der er flere gode transportmuligheder både til og fra kommunen, og der går S-tog hvert 10. minut fra Allerød Station.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.

We partner with major global platforms such as , Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes a separate fintech entity with its flagship product, PRECISION, a risk management solution, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site , Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, and Wenrix, the embedded AI platform for flights. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.

Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.

Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.

The Team: Platform Services

At the heart of this technology is the Platform Services team, a highly technical group responsible for maintaining and evolving the foundational aspects of the Etraveli Group platform. Our mission is to ensure we have a robust environment to build, deliver, and run services—from the very first lines of code in a project to maintainable services running in production, whether in AWS or our own datacenters.

We manage our CI/CD setup and cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), providing project templates and architectural support to development teams and strategically important projects. Today, the team consists of a collaborative mix of cloud infrastructure specialists and tech-focused senior developers.

The Role

As we grow and expand our support for new teams and projects, we are looking for a Hands-on Architect ( or Senior Software Engineer) to strengthen our organization.

In this role, you will be a key voice in discussions—both within the team and across the organization—on how to best design and solve complex technical tasks. You will certainly draw boxes and arrows on whiteboards to map out designs, but also write and update the code within our templates and CI/CD pipelines to support our developers.

Requirements

To be a good fit for this role, we believe you possess the following qualifications:

  • Experience: At least 10 years as a software developer and/or architect.

  • CI/CD & Kubernetes: At least some experience with CI/CD (and a willingness to become an expert) and a strong understanding of Kubernetes—including the ability to write and troubleshoot manifest files independently.

  • Mentorship: You enjoy supporting other developers and can discuss complex software solutions with both teams and stakeholders.

  • Java Expertise: Extensive experience as a Java backend developer, very comfortable in a senior capacity.

  • Polyglot Mindset: Experience with programming languages beyond just Java.

  • Broad Technical Interest: An interest in the underlying infrastructure required to run services, as well as a passion for service architecture and IaC (without being "married" to a single tool).

  • Tech Stack Knowledge: Meaningful experience in several of the following: Kubernetes, Helm, AWS, Linux, shell scripting, Git, Jenkins, Groovy, Typescript, React, Python, MySQL, Couchbase, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Terraform, CDK, CloudFormation, Gradle, Spring Boot, OpenSearch, Prometheus, Grafana, observability, security, networking, and testing.

  • Communication: Comfortable speaking and writing in English.

Benefits

At the Etraveli Group Gothenburg office, you will be part of +200 people, all with different cutting-edge skills and personalities. Our shared ambition, passion, and strong work ethic are what drive us toward the same goals. This foundation allows us to value our individual differences, which we believe are precisely what make us a strong team. With us you can enjoy:

  • Our office is located in Merkurhuset in Gothenburg, a few steps away from public transport and lunch restaurants.

  • We work on a hybrid-model where you can choose to work two days from home and you have two weeks per year that you can choose to work from a remote location

  • We love gaming and after work activities.

  • We know the value of personal development and continuous training.

  • Hackathons and Dev Weeks - We believe in promoting creativity and trying new things.

  • Healthcare allowance – Each employee receives a maximum allowable amount each year according to the Swedish Tax Agency to spend on health-promoting activities such as a gym card, massage etc.

  • Pension and health insurance – Through partners we offer a comprehensive pension and health insurance so that you can get help quickly in case of an accident.

  • Daily breakfast – To kick the day off just right, breakfast is available at the office every morning.

As part of this recruitment process, we will be conducting background checks. You will be able to read more information and give your consent to this process in the application form.

Diversity disclaimer

At Etraveli Group we value diversity; we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds. During hiring, we are committed to ensure equality and promote diversity in the workplace at every selection stage. As such, we provide the same opportunities for all candidates regardless of race, religion or belief, gender, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected under any anti-discrimination law or regulation.

title: Ultrasound Vascular Technologist II
location: HM Baytown - Medical Office Building - Garth
description:
At Houston Methodist, the Ultrasound/Vascular Technologist II position is an experienced Technologist who completes a variety of routine to highly complex diagnostic Ultrasound procedures to include common and special ultrasound exams of high difficulty, including vascular ultrasound exams. This position is a member of the direct patient care team and is fully competent in all aspects of ultrasound exams. The Ultrasound/Vascular Technologist II position serves as a mentor to Ultrasound Technologist I and students by utilizing skills and knowledge to help train and educate others. This position works independently by exercising sound judgment and executing above average clinical skills on challenging diagnostic procedures and patient care situations. The Ultrasound/Vascular Technologist II position provides direct assistance to physicians with all diagnostic and special ultrasound procedures. This position delivers exceptional patient care and adheres to ultrasound exam standards and guidelines established by governing agencies to ensure optimal patient safety and customer service.

PRN as needed

FLSA STATUS
Non-exempt

QUALIFICATIONS

EDUCATION
  • Graduate of education program approved by the credentialing body for the required credential(s) indicated below in the Certifications, Licenses and Registrations section.

EXPERIENCE
  • Three years’ experience as a Ultrasound Technologist

LICENSES AND CERTIFICATIONS
Required
  • BLS - Basic Life Support or Instructor (AHA) - American Heart Association and
  • Must have one of the following certifications: RDMS-OB - Registered Diagnostic Medical Sonographer - OB/GYN (ARDMS); RDMS-AB - Registered Diagnostic Medical Sonographer - Abdomen (ARDMS); RDMS-BR - Registered Diagnostic Medical Sonographer - Breast (ARDMS); ARRT-SON - Radiologic Technologist - Sonography (ARRT); RCS - Registered Cardiac Sonographer (CCI)

SKILLS AND ABILITIES
  • Demonstrates the skills and competencies necessary to safely perform the assigned job, determined through on-going skills, competency assessments, and performance evaluations
  • Sufficient proficiency in speaking, reading, and writing the English language necessary to perform the essential functions of this job, especially with regard to activities impacting patient or employee safety or security
  • Ability to effectively communicate with patients, physicians, family members and co-workers in a manner consistent with a customer service focus and application of positive language principles
  • Ability to work independently; capable of handling challenging / difficult diagnostic procedures and patient care situations. Demonstrates sound judgment and executes above average clinical skills.
  • Possesses basic computer knowledge; operates multiple computer systems to include, Hospital / Radiology Information Systems and Office software to maintain patient and exam documents.
  • Exhibits strong interpersonal and team player skills with all levels of the healthcare team and assures delivery of excellent customer service to all patients, visitors, physicians and co-workers.
  • Adapts to multiple ongoing priorities with minimal supervision including, organizing work flow and actively participating in problem-solving.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

PEOPLE ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • Promotes a positive work environment and contributes to a dynamic, team focused work unit that actively helps one another to achieve optimal department results. Collaborates with all members of the patient care team by actively communicating and reporting pertinent patient care information and data in a comprehensive manner.
  • Guides and mentors Ultrasound Technologist I and students to help build confidence in skills, knowledge and abilities. Uses peer-to-peer accountability towards department goals for retention and employee engagement
  • Facilitates open, professional (verbal, nonverbal, written) communication to achieve mutual understanding, role modeling by example. Communication to promote both work efforts and problem resolution is clear and professional, providing the highest quality service during every customer and patient encounter.

SERVICE ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • Performs diagnostic ultrasound procedures to include common and special ultrasound exams. Also able to perform vascular ultrasound exams. Ultrasound exams use high-frequency sound waves to capture images.
  • Proactively assesses, identifies and responds to the needs of the patient for adjustment or intervention to optimize patient care, image quality and patient experience. This includes: positioning, physiology, procedure preparation, and technical factors. Modifies technical factors to achieve desired imaging results and recognizes complications and limitations associated with certain procedures.
  • Provides direct assistance to physicians during diagnostic procedures or special ultrasound procedures, including assisting with sterile technique.
  • Provides accurate explanations and instructions to patients and family members at an appropriate level utilizing verbal and non-verbal skills, terminology and language.

QUALITY/SAFETY ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • Follows safety standards and conducts all imaging procedures accordingly. Maintains proper sterile techniques for procedures, regularly practices aseptic techniques, and ensures compliance with infection control procedures. Complies with job role, department and hospital safety standards, practices and policies.
  • Identifies opportunities for corrective action and process improvement providing recommendations, and contributes to meeting department and hospital targets for quality and safety. Reports “near misses” and inputs errors promptly into appropriate hospital patient safety reporting system to improve processes and identify trends. Utilizes critical thinking skills to observe and proactively address patient reactions (i.e. contrast media and medications) or potential outcomes, as appropriate.
  • Ensures all imaging equipment has had quality control (QC) performed as required and is in safe working order prior to use. Reports any malfunctions to management and regularly practices preventative maintenance procedures; calls for service if needed.
  • Assists with implementation and education of department based safety initiatives and standards of practice.

FINANCE ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • Provides accurate and complete documentation of patient procedures. Enters charges at the time service is delivered.
  • Uses resources efficiently; does not waste supplies. Self-motivated to independently manage time effectively and prioritize daily tasks.

GROWTH/INNOVATION ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • Actively participates in special projects, department initiatives or shared governance activities and seeks opportunities to expand learning with a focus on continual development. Completes and updates the individual development plan (IDP) on an on-going basis.
  • Fosters a positive and constructive teaching environment by engaging students and co-workers (Ultrasound Technologist I) in learning opportunities that are valuable and in alignment with business objectives.

title: Member of Technical Staff, Enterprise Foundations
description:
About Us:

Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI.

THE ROLE

Enterprise Foundations builds the capabilities the largest companies in the world need before they can run their business on Fireworks. Global banks, insurers, healthcare and legal technology companies, and large-scale SaaS platforms are moving AI into production now, and they arrive with requirements that only apply to scaled companies: how their organization and users are modeled, who is allowed to do what, how usage is metered and billed, what gets logged, where data lives and who holds the keys, and whether the whole thing can run inside their own cloud.

You will own that work as end-to-end features. A single project routinely starts in a customer conversation, becomes a change to a core data model or API, and then has to be threaded through the control plane, the training and inference stacks, the SDK and CLI, and the console before it counts as shipped. Much of what we build is a foundational shift rather than an addition: a new primitive that other teams' code has to move onto, rolled out against live production traffic without breaking anyone.

The work sits close to revenue. Requirements come out of live enterprise deals, security reviews, and customer conversations. You will be in those rooms, decide what product becomes, and go build it.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own foundational capabilities end to end — data model and API through control plane, runtime, SDK/CLI, and console — and migrate live systems onto them

  • Design the primitives large customers organize around — organizations and sub-accounts, groups, roles, service identities — and connect them to enterprise directories through federation and provisioning (SSO, SCIM)

  • Design multi-tenant authorization, policy enforcement, and audit systems that hold up in front of a security architect

  • Make usage metering, spend controls, and billing correct and legible at scale — customers reconcile our numbers against their own

  • Own data isolation and key management — customer-managed encryption keys across AWS, GCP, and Azure — threaded through datasets, fine-tuning, RL, checkpoints, models, and inference

  • Deploy and operate Fireworks inside a customer's own cloud, and solve data residency and regional isolation for customers with hard constraints

  • Use AI tooling aggressively — we expect you to automate yourself

YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF

  • You want your work measured in unblocked revenue, not tickets closed

  • You're comfortable owning domains you've never worked in before

  • You want the whole problem — data model through UI — and don't need someone else to draw the edges for you

  • You can hold your own with an enterprise security architect

  • You'd rather ship what closes the deal than perfect the abstraction

  • You treat ambiguity as the job, not a complaint about the job

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • 2+ years building and operating production backend or distributed systems at scale

  • Strong server-side engineering skills in Go, Python, C++, TypeScript, or similar, and willingness to work outside your primary layer to land a feature

  • Experience designing APIs and data models that other teams build on, and evolving them under live traffic without breaking callers

  • Hands-on depth in at least one major cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure): IAM and workload identity, KMS, object storage, and VPC networking

  • A track record of owning an ambiguous, cross-team workstream from requirement through production

  • Willingness to work directly with customers

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience building for regulated enterprises — financial services, healthcare, or similar — including SOC 2 and customer security reviews

  • Enterprise identity and tenancy: SSO, SCIM provisioning, RBAC/ABAC, audit logging, and org modeling

  • Metering, quotas, or billing systems where correctness is customer-visible

  • Applied cryptography and key management: envelope encryption, KMS, and threat modeling

  • Kubernetes depth and infrastructure-as-code fluency (Terraform, GitOps)

  • Familiarity with LLM inference and fine-tuning — our work runs straight through the training and serving stacks, so it helps

Why Fireworks?

  • Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving.

  • Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally.

  • Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results.

  • Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation.

Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

title: Security Compliance Specialist
description:
Location: Remote First; office location Moorgate, London (flexible remote working locations within UK/Europe)

Employment type: Permanent (open to contract as well)

Working Hours: Full-time (UK 9-6)

Salary: dependent on experience up to £75,000 + Shares + Benefits

We are hiring to enhance our Security and Compliance efforts. In this role, you will work closely with Security Compliance, Senior Leadership, and Site Reliability Engineering to support our GRC initiatives.

We provide a low-latency, high-throughput distributed messaging system to the e-trading Fixed-income markets. We are, foremost, a technology service provider and support for part of our customers’ trading infrastructure.

You will help maintain positive customer relationships by handling compliance questions and ensuring our security practices are effective and up to date.

Here’s what you’ll be doing:

  • Stakeholder Communication and Reporting: respond to customer security questionnaires and produce management reports on security compliance and metrics for relevant committees.

  • Contribute to and Improve Compliance Programmes: contribute to internal control evaluations and testing to ensure adherence. Ensure compliance with industry standards such as GDPR, DORA, NIS2, ISO 27001, and SOC 2. Coordinate responses to internal and external audits, and support security assessments, including third-party penetration tests.

  • Risk Management and Issue Resolution: contribute to the maintenance of the risk assessment process to identify, evaluate, and mitigate potential risks. Triage security issues and provide recommended solutions.

To be successful in this role, we require:

  • 4+ years of experience in security compliance, GRC, or infosec roles

  • Experience answering complex compliance questionnaires, ideally from Banks or highly regulated organisations

  • Experience in developing and implementing information security policies, standards and procedures

  • Experience leading ISO27001 and SOC 2 certification processes

  • Familiarity with standards and frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST CSF, as well as legal frameworks such as DORA, NIS2, and GDPR

Bonus points if you:

  • Have experience working with Vanta or similar GRC automation tools

  • Can comprehend penetration test and vulnerability scan results

  • Have startup experience or experience working in a fast-moving environment

  • Are comfortable using technical tools, CLIs, or basic scripting to improve compliance workflows

description:
Ecolab es líder global en soluciones de agua, higiene y prevención de infecciones, con presencia en más de 170 países.

Nos encontramos en la búsqueda de una persona para cubrir la posición de Logistics Team Leader, con base en Apodaca, Nuevo León.

Cómo vas a impactar

Serás responsable de liderar las operaciones de almacén durante tu turno, asegurando el cumplimiento de los estándares de seguridad, calidad y productividad. A través de la gestión efectiva de personal, inventarios, sistemas y procesos logísticos, contribuirás al cumplimiento de los objetivos operativos del negocio y a la satisfacción de nuestros clientes.

Principales responsabilidades

  • Coordinar las operaciones de almacén durante el turno asignado.

  • Gestionar asistencia, tiempos y horas extra de personal sindicalizado.

  • Investigar incidentes y accidentes de seguridad.

  • Asegurar el cumplimiento de las normativas de Seguridad, Higiene y Medio Ambiente (SHE).

  • Realizar análisis de causa raíz de incidentes operativos o quejas de clientes.

  • Administrar materiales con fecha de caducidad bajo metodología FEFO y gestionar materiales no conformes.

  • Mantener actualizados los sistemas ERP y WMS para asegurar la confiabilidad de los inventarios.

  • Elaborar, monitorear y dar seguimiento a indicadores clave de desempeño (KPIs).

  • Coordinar mantenimientos preventivos y correctivos de los equipos bajo su responsabilidad.

  • Supervisar las actividades de 5S y limpieza general del almacén.

Requisitos mínimos

  • Licenciatura o Ingeniería concluida.

  • Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en logística y/o gestión de almacenes de producto terminado.

  • Mínimo 2 años de experiencia utilizando sistemas ERP y WMS.

  • Experiencia en supervisión de operaciones logísticas y administración de inventarios.

Requisitos deseados

  • Manejo de sistemas WMS e interfaces.

  • Conocimiento de operaciones de última milla.

  • Conocimiento de ruteo y transporte.

  • Conocimiento de dashboards e indicadores de desempeño.

  • Experiencia en centros de distribución o almacenes de alta rotación.

Habilidades y competencias

  • Manejo de personal sindicalizado y personal de confianza.

  • Liderazgo.

  • Gestión de KPIs.

  • Capacidad analítica.

  • Comunicación efectiva.

  • Trabajo en equipo.

  • Organización y planeación.

  • Capacidad para trabajar bajo presión.

  • Manejo avanzado de Excel.

Detalles de la Posición

  • Ubicación: Apodaca, Nuevo León.

  • Horario: Rotación de dos turnos:

    • Turno A: 6:00 a.m. a 2:00 p.m.

    • Turno B: 2:00 p.m. a 10:00 p.m.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Affinity stitches together billions of data points from massive datasets to create a powerful, accurate representation of the world's professional relationship graph. Based on this data, we offer our users the insights and visibility they need to nurture and tap into the opportunities in their team's network.

This role is part of the AI Platform team, which owns the AI services that power Affinity's industry-leading relationship intelligence platform. We extract and retrieve information from billions of structured and unstructured data points to deliver actionable insights to customers.

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will collaborate with data engineers, software engineers, and product managers to shape the future of private capital's leading CRM platform. You will design and build AI systems that efficiently uncover insights from compelling business interaction data – an exciting and unique opportunity within the industry.

This is an applied machine learning position with a strong emphasis on engineering, rather than research. You will play a key role in advancing our ML Engineering capabilities, particularly in information retrieval and eventually recommendation systems.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Own the full ML lifecycle: Take projects from ideation to production, including feature engineering, model selection, deployment, and model observability and evaluation.

  • Translate business needs into ML solutions: Gather product requirements and translate them into robust ML system design requirements.

  • Build recommendation and ranking systems: Architect and launch ranking and recommendation infrastructure from scratch, initially via integrated off-the-shelf models, and evolving to targeted and customized solutions in the long term.

  • Solve complex problems: Work on a variety of information extraction, information storage and information retrieval problems for both structured and unstructured data.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with cross-functional (product, infra, data engineering, and software engineering) teams to build robust, high-scale systems that underlie all of our data processing and ML Operations.

Qualifications

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every qualification. At Affinity, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role, but your past experience doesn’t perfectly align with the qualifications above, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Required:

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering and/or Machine Learning experience in applying machine learning in production.

  • Hands-on experience developing ranking or recommendation systems from scratch, deployed at scale using techniques such as learn-to-rank, explainable recommendations

  • Strong understanding of machine learning techniques, including clustering and decision trees

  • Experience with serving ML models for streaming and batch inference at scale.

  • Experience with vector or graph databases.

  • Proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, Scikit-learn, or similar).

  • Track record of building maintainable, testable, and production-grade codebases.

  • Experience with observability tools for online and offline model evaluation, A/B testing, and tracing for AI applications.

Nice to Have:

title: SAP CONCUR SYSTEM ADMINISTRATOR
description:
SAP Concur System Administrator

Brisbane | Permanent Full-Time | Up to $125,000

We are seeking an experienced SAP Concur System Administrator to join a growing organisation and take ownership of the administration, configuration and ongoing operational support of the SAP Concur Expense platform.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is confident working independently and enjoys being the go-to technical expert for SAP Concur. You’ll be responsible for maintaining the platform, supporting configuration changes and policy updates, managing integrations and resolving complex system issues.

What you'll be doing

  • Own the day-to-day administration and configuration of SAP Concur Expense.
  • Manage expense types, policies, audit rules, approval workflows and cost object/account code mapping.
  • Support UAT, testing and cutover activities for system changes, policy rollouts and new functionality.
  • Manage and troubleshoot integrations between SAP Concur and other systems, including SAP SuccessFactors.
  • Monitor system performance, data integrity and file/interface feeds, resolving errors and reconciliation issues.
  • Manage user provisioning, roles and permission groups.
  • Coordinate Concur releases, feature updates and regression testing.
  • Act as the escalation point for complex incidents and service requests.
  • Develop and maintain system documentation, SOPs and technical runbooks.
  • Support audit and compliance requirements relating to expense management.

What we're looking for

  • Strong hands-on experience administering and configuring SAP Concur, ideally across the Concur Expense module.
  • Experience with expense types, audit rules, approval workflows, policy groups and user access.
  • Experience supporting a Concur implementation, major redesign or policy/module rollout.
  • Understanding of Concur integrations and technologies such as SFTP, Concur Connect/CTE, card feeds, OAuth and SSO.
  • Experience managing release cycles, testing and system changes.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently while engaging effectively with Finance, HR and IT stakeholders.
  • Experience with SAP SuccessFactors integrations will be highly regarded.

What's on offer

This is a permanent, full-time opportunity paying up to $125,000, based in Brisbane. The role is primarily on-site, with some flexibility to work from home.

If you're an experienced SAP Concur professional looking for a hands-on role where you can take real ownership of the platform, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now or reach out directly to samb@spellerinternational.com for a confidential conversation.

title: Residential Solar PV Apprentice
description:
Why Apply?

Do you want to support the shift to clean, renewable energy? Advance your career with our exclusive training program! You'll learn about best practices in Residential Solar Installation, how to utilize the National Electrical Code (NEC), and how Solar PV is helping to shape the future of energy. With our 6-month performance evaluations, this position will put you on a path with the CO Department of Regulatory Agencies (DORA) to become a licensed electrician.

Are you interested in generous time-off and a strong benefits package? At Namaste Solar, you'll also have the opportunity to become a co-owner in our inclusive and transparent cooperative business.

People come to Namaste Solar with a desire to align their work and their values. And, we're not the only ones that believe our employee-owned model is a force for good in our communities. We've been awarded B Corp's Best for Workers and Outside Magazine's Best Places to Work 7+ years in a row.

Position Summary:

Residential Solar Apprentice

The Residential Solar Apprentice is a full-time role, responsible for supporting all aspects of project installation. This person works with a crew to complete array installation including layout, roof attachment, racking and module assembly, combiner box installation, home run wiring, battery installation and commissioning.

Responsibilities:

  • Ensure personal, crew and job site safety at all times
  • Ensure all necessary materials and tools arrive to the job site
  • Ensure all solar and storage installations are completed to system design specifications and meet expected top-quality standards
  • Ensure install resources are optimally utilized
  • Provide excellent customer service to homeowners
  • Assist with delivery of installation documentation in a timely manner
  • Support tool management and proper maintenance of install vehicle

Essential Functions (Specific Tasks/Deliverables):

  • Stage materials and tools and load vans
  • Perform quality roof penetrations
  • Assemble racking and mounting systems
  • Place and attach panels
  • Ground and wire modules and combiner box
  • Perform voltage testing
  • Assist with general site preparation and clean up
  • Driving to customer sites and Namaste Solar offices

Standards & Expectations:

  • Develop skills and knowledge in solar PV and Storage installations
  • Participate in 3-5 PV system installations per week
  • Assist with completion of installation reports day of installation
  • Assure installations are above industry quality standards
  • Maintain tool management standards
  • Complete required safety training quarterly
  • Excellent teamwork skills – ability to foster a positive team environment through collaborative decision making and effective communication

Qualifications:

  • Experience working in construction
  • Basic understanding of solar PV installations
  • Understanding of tool use and familiarity with construction best practices
  • Comfortably able to lift 50 lbs., climb ladders, work with tools, and work on rooftops in varying temperatures
  • Have reliable transportation to work along the front range and a clean driving record
  • Have a basic set of hand tools
  • Good at problem solving and following directions
  • Highly organized and good follow through
  • Able to multi-task and set priorities
  • Effectively coordinate and communicate with others
  • Able to succeed in a fast paced, community environment

Valued but not required skills & experience:

  • NABCEP certification
  • OSHA-10 safety certification
  • Previous experience installing solar PV
  • Ability to read and understand field layouts
  • Basic understanding of grid-tied PV system design
  • Basic understanding of electrical wire sizing and conduit connections
  • Previous experience as a foreman or crew leader
  • Proficient with computers and the following applications: Microsoft Office Suite, Salesforce, and Smartsheets

Physical demands & work environment:

  • Ability to commute to Boulder or Denver office/job sites as required.
  • Physical demands: While performing the duties of this job, employee is required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; talk and hear. Employee must lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Must be able to lift and climb ladders to access roofs. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. Driving required to site locations
  • Work environment: The noise level in this work environment is usually moderate. Work environment changes from day to day: installation on roofs of all pitches. The daily temperature varies from hot to cold depending on the season.

Compensation and Benefits:

  • Compensation is dependent on experience, certifications, and licenses.
  • Paid time off including Sick Pay, Designated Holidays and Vacation
  • Insurance coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision) within the first 30 days
  • Company-paid life insurance, short- and long-term disability
  • 401k plan
  • Voluntary life insurance
  • Paid volunteer time
  • Employee assistance program
  • EcoPass to ride RTD
  • Discount to put solar on your home

Application Deadline

These ads will remain open at least until Friday, August 28th 2026. We reserve the right to extend this application deadline with or without notice. If you have questions regarding your application, please send inquiries to workwithus@namastesolar.com. Please do not call, email is the best way to reach us.

Equal Employment Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other factors prohibited by law.

title: Pædagogmedhjælpere søges til Børnehuset Blommehavens børnehave og vuggestue
description:
Ønsker du at arbejde i et børnehus som har en fagligt stærk personalegruppe, som vægter faglig udvikling og medindflydelse på egen hverdag højt? Da vores dygtige unge mennesker skal studere, søger vi medhjælpere til Børnehuset Blommehavens børnehave og vuggestue pr. 1. oktober 2026.

Stillingerne er som udgangspunkt på fuldtid, men vi er åbne for andre ønsker. Arbejdstiden ligger i tidsrummet 6.45-16.45 samt ca. et aftenmøde pr. måned.

Om stillingen
Børnehuset Blommehaven i Allerød Kommune er en integreret 0 - 6 års institution med afdelingerne Viktoria og Engblommen. Husene ligger ved siden af hinanden og vi deler legeplads. Vi er normeret til 42 børnehavebørn og 24 vuggestuebørn i hvert hus.

Vi arbejder ud fra den nye styrkede pædagogiske læreplan og tager udgangspunkt i børnenes perspektiv, når vi planlægger vores pædagogiske aktiviteter. Vi arbejder med læringsmiljøer hele dagen, og har fokus på børnenes deltagelsesmuligheder for at sikre den kvalitet der skaber trivsel, læring, udvikling og dannelse hos børnene.

Vi er en fagligt stærk personalegruppe, som vægter faglig udvikling og medindflydelse på egen hverdag højt. Vi er et hus med et godt psykisk arbejdsmiljø, hvor der er god stemning, en åben og ærlig kommunikation samt en nærværende og respektfuld tilgang til hinanden. AMR og ledelsen arbejder løbende med trivsel for alle. Vi holder løbende sparringsmøder og sætter tid af til pædagogisk planlægning i hverdagen.

Vi har et fantastisk udeliv: stor legeplads med mange muligheder, gode el-ladcykler som vi bruger til længere ture samt ”Koglen” som er vores udeværksted på legepladsen.

Om dig
Dine personlige egenskaber og erfaringsflader:

  • Er nærværende og kan arbejde i børnehøjde på gulvet
  • Gerne tidligere erfaring som medhjælper eller andet arbejde med børn
  • Du er god til at samarbejde og parat til at bruge egne kompetencer på tværs af grupper

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Med et positivt menneskesyn, er medansvarlig for at løse de pædagogiske opgaver i Børnehuset Blommehaven
  • Er energisk, nysgerrig, åben og imødekommende over for børnene
  • Er parat til at indgå i en travl hverdag og kan bevare overblikket
  • Har mod til at reflektere over egen såvel som fælles praksis med henblik på udvikling
  • I samarbejde med kollegaer og den pædagogiske leder tilegner dig viden om børns udvikling.
  • I samarbejde med kollegaer kan strukturere hverdagen

Derfor skal du vælge os

  • Vi er to huse der arbejder med både det nære i basisgrupper og med det brede på tværs af grupperne under hensyntagen til børnenes alder og udviklingstrin
  • Vi arbejder som teams i både vuggestue og børnehave
  • Vi bruger hverdagssparring som afsat for pædagogisk udvikling
  • Den pædagogiske leder er tilgængelig for sparring og drøftelse i hverdagen og deltager i møder/samtaler, der hvor vi sammen vurderer, det er hensigtsmæssigt
  • Vi har en meget engageret forældregruppe, som er rigtig god til at påskønne vores arbejde i hverdagen

Du kan søge flere oplysninger om os på vores hjemmeside lillevangklyngen.aula.dk

I Allerød Kommune arbejder vi ud fra vores Børne- og ungepolitik med dertilhørende underliggende børne- og læringssyn.

Allerød Kommune er en arbejdsplads med høj social kapital. Vi vægter tværfagligt samarbejde, kompetence- og jobudvikling og ikke mindst medindflydelse på egen hverdag højt. Det vigtigste for os er vores kerneopgave - at skabe værdi for borgerne.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår vil blive fastsat efter gældende overenskomst.

Er du interesseret?
Du er velkommen til at kontakte pædagogisk leder Mette Scherling Fris tlf. 21 74 48 84 for at høre nærmere om stillingerne i Blommehaven. Du uploader din ansøgning sammen med dit CV via linket i annoncen senest 4. september 2026. Vi forventer at holde ansættelsessamtaler løbende og indhenter referencer og straffe oplysninger forud for endelig ansættelse.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning.

Kommunen har ca. 2.000 medarbejdere, der arbejder ud fra et fælles Leder- og Medarbejdergrundlag, hvor værdier som dialog, samarbejde, respekt og faglighed er hjørnesten. Her kan du læse Allerød Kommunes Leder- og Medarbejdergrundlag.

Organisationen baserer sig på flade strukturer, stor medindflydelse og gode udviklingsmuligheder. Allerød Kommune er en røgfri arbejdsplads med røgfri arbejdstid.

Vi tror på, at mangfoldighed hos vores medarbejdere styrker vores organisation og løsningen af den fælles kerneopgave. Vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede ansøgere til at søge stillingen uanset køn, kønsidentitet, alder, handicap, etnisk baggrund eller seksuel orientering.

Allerød Kommune ligger i hjertet af Nordsjælland i en smuk og varieret natur. Kommunen har tæt på 26.000 indbyggere og byder på et aktivt forenings- og erhvervsliv med gode idræts- og fritidsmuligheder.

Der er flere gode transportmuligheder både til og fra kommunen, og der går S-tog hvert 10. minut fra Allerød Station.

Company Description

Work with Us. Change the World.

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.

We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Job Description

Join AECOM’s Melbourne Ground Engineering and Tunnelling Team to advance your technical and consulting skills. As a Senior Geotechnical Engineer, you will support the delivery of geotechnical investigations, analysis, and design solutions as part of a collaborative and high-performing team of Engineers, Engineering Geologists, and Hydrogeologists.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical input and oversight from investigation through to design and construction phases.
  • Support geotechnical analysis and design for foundations, slope stability, earthworks, pavements, and other structures.
  • Prepare Geotechnical Interpretive Reports, including provision of geotechnical design parameters.
  • Lead, plan, coordinate, and supervise geotechnical site investigations (drilling, sampling, in-situ testing).
  • Manage soil and rock sample collection, laboratory testing programs, and factual reporting.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant standards, guidelines, and safety procedures.
  • Assist in bid preparation, scope development, and preliminary cost estimation.
  • Mentor junior staff and support collaborative project delivery.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role, you must have experience that includes carrying out and leading geotechnical investigations, preparing Geotechnical Interpretive Reports, and some experience in geotechnical analysis and design.

You will be motivated to build your technical capability and to work collaboratively in teams, both in the office and in the field.

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in civil engineering or geological equivalent.

The qualities that help you thrive

  • 6–8 years’ experience in geotechnical engineering, with demonstrated capability in both geotechnical site investigations and geotechnical analysis and design.
  • Proven ability to deliver technical analysis and design as well as manage and interpret geotechnical investigations.
  • Proficiency with geotechnical software (OpenGround/gINT, Rocscience, GeoStudio, SLOPE/W, Leapfrog or similar).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to work independently and in multidisciplinary teams.
  • Current Class C driver’s licence.
  • Willingness to undertake fieldwork and travel.

Additional Information
