title: Project Software Engineer / Project Software Developer
description:
Job Description

Job Description

Project Software Engineer / Project Software Developer Company SummaryTriton Systems, Inc combines 30+ years of experience with exciting growth and innovation opportunities within the product development and R&D space. We support Government and commercial markets by delivering advanced solutions across applications in defense, security, aerospace, energy, environmental sustainability, and human health. Where we see a larger opportunity, we create new companies to scale these solutions into businesses. Our teams thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment where we tackle complex challenges, meet our customers' toughest requirements, and deliver high-impact results on time, on budget and have fun while doing it.Position SummaryWe are seeking a versatile Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience to support our Applied Computational Engineering group, with cross-cutting support to our Ocean Systems and Sustainment groups. This is a role for a self-directed engineer who thrives juggling multiple projects in a fast-paced, quick-turnaround environment.A primary focus of this role is transforming research-level code into production-ready software: secure, optimized for runtime performance, user-friendly, clean, and modular, and integrated with other software systems (for example, via well-defined APIs). The codebase is primarily C++, so strong C++ proficiency is essential, complemented by competency across additional languages including Python, MATLAB, and Java. Strong skills in coding, debugging, design, problem-solving, technical writing, and presentations are required, along with the ability to manage multiple projects and work both independently and collaboratively. Another core component of this role is the ability to develop and apply novel artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) methods and algorithms to solve challenging technical problems across our customer base.This position is scoped to accommodate a range of experience. Candidates with 5+ years will be considered at the Project Software Engineer level, while candidates bringing deeper experience (up to ~15 years) may be considered at a more senior level commensurate with their background. Duties and ResponsibilitiesSoftware Development and EngineeringMature research-level code into production-ready software that is secure, robust, optimized, clean, and modular.Refactor, optimize, and harden existing C++ code for performance, robustness, and maintainability.Apply secure coding practices throughout the development lifecycle to deliver cybersecure software.Apply runtime optimization techniques such as parallelization or GPU acceleration to improve performance.Execute systems engineering tasking, including requirements definition, architecture, interface design, and integration planning.AI/ML and Algorithm DevelopmentDevelop, apply, and implement novel AI/ML methods and algorithms to address customer and program needs.Translate AI/ML research and prototypes into robust, deployable, production-ready software.Evaluate, benchmark, and optimize AI/ML models for accuracy, performance, and runtime efficiency.Integration and User ExperienceDesign and integrate software interfaces with other software systems (e.g., via APIs).Support UI/UX design and GUI development to deliver intuitive, user-friendly software.Establish and maintain documentation, version control, testing, and build/integration workflows.Collaboration and Customer SupportCoordinate and balance a diverse portfolio of tasks to support engineers across the company.Support customer meetings, demonstrations, and other externally facing activities.Document progress and results through reports and presentations to team members and customers.Collaborate with multidisciplinary technical teams and communicate progress, risks, and results clearly. Required QualificationsU.S. Citizen with an active Secret clearance or the ability to obtain and maintain one.Experienced developer with strong coding, debugging, design, and problem-solving skills.Strong proficiency in C++, with working competency across additional languages such as Python, MATLAB, and Java.Experience developing and applying AI/ML methods and algorithms.Demonstrated experience taking software from prototype/research code to robust, production-ready quality.Experience with secure coding practices and software cybersecurity fundamentals.Familiarity with secure development frameworks or DoD cyber compliance practices.Experience using collaborative source code management (Git, Subversion), Agile Development, and DevSecOps.Strong organizational skills with the ability to multi-task, readily adapt to change, and respond to quick-turnaround requests.Self-starter who is highly organized, professional, and able to work both independently and as part of a team.Strong skills in technical writing, documentation, and presentations. Desired QualificationsSignal processing experience.UI/UX design and GUI development experience.Experience with trajectory simulation.Experience designing and integrating APIs and software interfaces across heterogeneous systems.Familiarity with modeling, simulation, and/or numerical/computational methods.Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and static analysis tools.Education/ExperienceBS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline. Advanced degree preferred.5+ years of relevant software development experience (additional experience considered for senior-level placement).This Software Engineer/Developer role will operate & collaborate with several teams at Triton Systems.The Ocean Systems group does operate around, in and on the ocean, year-round and in foul weather. This role requires field work and travel, and willingness to go and work at-sea for the day (or a couple of days) is expected. Firsthand knowledge of working in this environment is desired. In compliance with federal laws contained in the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986, all offers of employment are contingent upon an applicant's ability to satisfy federal requirements regarding proof of identity and the lawful right to be employed in the United States. Further, because in this position you may be given access to Confidential Unclassified Information (CUI), your continuing employment would then be contingent upon your satisfying a background check. Base salary range is dependent on experience and qualifications Due to the nature of our business and information associated with this position, interested candidates must be US Citizens. Triton Systems' Headquarters is located in Chelmsford, Massachusetts. Come join our success and grow with the strength of these fascinating new technologies. title: Agency Brand Design Expert
description:
This role is for one of our clients

Compensation: $80-$150 per hour

1. Overview

We are seeking experienced brand and visual design professionals to support a project focused on evaluating how effectively AI systems perform real-world brand and design work.

As an Agency Brand Design Expert, you will help define what exceptional professional design looks like by developing task-specific evaluation criteria and assessing completed work samples. You will review both AI-generated and human-created work and provide rigorous, well-reasoned feedback based on professional design standards.

This role is particularly suited to designers with experience at leading independent branding and design agencies who can bring strong creative judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to articulate why a design succeeds or falls short.

Requirements

2. Key Responsibilities

  • Develop precise, task-specific grading criteria for real-world brand and design deliverables, including:
    • Brand identity systems and guidelines
    • Logo design and visual identity
    • Campaign and marketing creatives
    • Packaging concepts
    • Presentation and layout design
    • Digital and social media assets
    • Brand messaging and positioning
  • Evaluate AI-generated and human-produced design work against established criteria.
  • Provide detailed written justifications explaining the reasoning behind each score or evaluation.
  • Assess design work for visual quality, strategic alignment, consistency, usability, and overall brand effectiveness.
  • Apply consistent, evidence-based creative judgment so evaluations remain reproducible and defensible.
  • Review work against professional standards for typography, composition, hierarchy, color, branding, and visual communication.
  • Incorporate structured feedback from senior reviewers and refine evaluations accordingly.
  • Help identify subtle design strengths, weaknesses, inconsistencies, and areas requiring improvement.

3. Ideal Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional experience in brand design, visual design, graphic design, or a closely related discipline.
  • Professional experience specifically within world-class independent branding or design agencies is strongly preferred.
  • Experience at organizations comparable to leading global design studios and brand consultancies.
  • Agency experience is preferred over experience limited to in-house or enterprise design teams.
  • Strong expertise in one or more core brand disciplines, including:
    • Creative Direction
    • Brand Design
    • Logo and Visual Identity Design
    • Web/UI/UX Design
    • Graphic Design
  • Deep understanding of:
    • Typography
    • Layout and visual hierarchy
    • Color theory and application
    • Composition
    • Logo development
    • Brand identity systems
    • Visual consistency
    • Creative direction and critique
  • Ability to articulate design feedback with the clarity and strategic perspective expected during a senior creative review.
  • Exceptional written communication skills, with the ability to explain precisely why a design does or does not meet professional standards.
  • Highly detail-oriented, consistent, and comfortable having creative judgment reviewed and calibrated against other experts.
  • Experience with copywriting, brand messaging, audience research, competitive analysis, or brand positioning is a strong advantage.
  • Prior experience with AI training, AI evaluation, rubric-based assessment, or human-data projects is a plus.

4. Application Process

  • Submit your resume, professional background, and portfolio to begin the application process.
  • A portfolio demonstrating relevant professional brand and design work is strongly preferred.
  • Qualified applicants may be asked to complete a brief design assessment or provide additional information about their experience.
  • Candidates will be evaluated based on their professional design expertise, creative judgment, attention to detail, and ability to communicate their reasoning clearly.

5. Engagement Details

  • Role: Agency Brand Design Expert
  • Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
  • Engagement Type: Independent Contractor
  • Schedule: Flexible, based on project requirements
  • Projects may be extended, shortened, or concluded early depending on project needs and performance.
  • Payments are made weekly based on services rendered through available payment platforms.
  • The engagement will not involve access to confidential or proprietary information belonging to any employer, client, or institution.

title: Data Architect (Databricks)
description:
Data Architect (Databricks)

Are you an experienced Data Architect with a strong background in modern data platforms, cloud-native architecture and Databricks? We're supporting a major programme that is modernising and transforming large-scale data processing capabilities and are looking for a hands-on architect who can bridge strategy, design and delivery.

The Role

This position will play a key role in shaping and delivering a cloud-based data platform built around AWS and Databricks. You'll work across architecture, engineering and stakeholder teams to define target-state solutions, modernise existing data services and establish scalable deployment patterns.

The successful candidate will be comfortable operating at both the architectural and technical implementation layers, helping to guide migration activity while remaining hands-on with infrastructure, automation and platform delivery.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design scalable data processing solutions using AWS, Databricks and associated cloud services.
  • Lead the transition of existing data workloads and integrations onto a modern cloud-native platform.
  • Define platform standards covering security, networking, governance, workspace configuration and deployment approaches.
  • Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and Databricks asset deployment frameworks.
  • Build and enhance CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and modern DevOps practices.
  • Configure, deploy and manage services across AWS and Databricks environments.
  • Integrate new platform capabilities with existing enterprise applications and data services.
  • Work closely with business and technical stakeholders to understand current-state architectures and migration priorities.
  • Provide technical leadership around streaming and batch processing, orchestration, observability, data quality and operational resilience.
  • Produce high-quality architecture documentation, implementation roadmaps and operational guidance.
Essential
  • Strong experience designing and delivering solutions within AWS cloud environments.
  • Proven expertise with Databricks architecture, implementation and operational management.
  • Experience building data platforms, pipelines and integration services at scale.
  • Hands-on Terraform experience for infrastructure provisioning and environment management.
  • Strong CI/CD knowledge, including GitHub Actions.
  • Understanding of modern data architecture principles including governance, security and observability.
  • Experience working across both solution design and technical delivery.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and documentation skills.
  • Active SC Clearance.
Desirable
  • Experience migrating legacy or on-premise data platforms into cloud-native environments.
  • Knowledge of streaming technologies and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience working within large, complex transformation programmes.
  • Exposure to master data management or enterprise data matching solutions.
The Details
  • Contract: 6 Months Initial Contract + extensions
  • IR35 Status: Inside IR35
  • Rate: £550-600p/d
  • Location: Primarily Remote with occasional travel to client sites as required
  • Clearance: Active SC Clearance Required

title: Psychiatry Expert
description:
This role is for one of our clients

Compensation: $150 per hour

We are seeking board-certified psychiatrists to support an expert evaluation project with a leading AI research organization.

The project focuses on assessing how effectively advanced AI systems reason through complex psychiatric scenarios. As a Psychiatry Expert, you will use your clinical expertise to develop challenging, expert-level diagnostic and reasoning tasks, establish authoritative reference answers, and identify common weaknesses in AI-generated clinical reasoning.

Psychiatrists from a range of practice settings are welcome, with particular interest in professionals with specialized expertise in psychiatry subspecialties.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop expert-level psychiatric cases and reasoning challenges designed to test advanced AI systems.
  • Create accurate, clinically rigorous, gold-standard answers supported by clear diagnostic and clinical reasoning.
  • Evaluate nuanced psychiatric scenarios, including complex differentials, edge cases, and risk-assessment considerations.
  • Review AI-generated responses and identify clinical inaccuracies, reasoning gaps, unsupported conclusions, and common failure patterns.
  • Provide structured feedback to help research teams understand and improve AI performance on advanced psychiatric tasks.
  • Collaborate directly with AI research teams and other subject-matter experts.
  • Apply current clinical knowledge and professional judgment consistently when evaluating model outputs.

Required Qualifications

  • Completed psychiatry residency through an ACGME, AOA, or recognized national-equivalent program. Current trainees do not qualify.
  • Medical degree: MD or DO. International medical degrees from recognized institutions are also eligible.
  • Active board certification in psychiatry, such as:
    • ABPN
    • FRCPC
    • MRCPsych
    • FRANZCP
    • Recognized national equivalent

  • Board-eligible or lapsed certifications do not meet the requirement.
  • Active, unrestricted medical license with no current suspension, revocation, or open disciplinary action.
  • 3+ years of independent clinical practice after residency, either currently or within the past two years. Residency and fellowship training do not count toward this requirement.
  • Current or recent practice in an accredited or government-licensed clinical setting, including hospitals, academic medical centers, community clinics, private practices, or telehealth organizations.
  • Must be based in the United States, United Kingdom, Europe, or Australia. US-based candidates are preferred.
  • Psychiatry must be the primary area of professional practice.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are valued but are not mandatory:

  • 10+ hours per week of direct patient care, currently.
  • Specialized expertise in one or more of the following areas:
    • Addiction Psychiatry
    • Child & Adolescent Psychiatry
    • Forensic Psychiatry
    • Geriatric Psychiatry
    • Consultation-Liaison Psychiatry

  • Subspecialty expertise demonstrated through a fellowship, subspecialty board certification, or at least two years of relevant clinical practice.
  • Experience developing or administering OSCEs, including examiner or assessment-development experience.
  • Current or recent faculty appointment within a psychiatry department.
  • Experience reviewing, evaluating, grading, or developing clinical or medical educational content.

Role Responsibilities

As part of the engagement, you may be asked to:

  • Develop clinically challenging psychiatric scenarios for AI evaluation.
  • Produce authoritative answers with transparent and well-structured clinical reasoning.
  • Focus on nuanced differentials, psychiatric risk assessment, diagnostic uncertainty, and clinical edge cases.
  • Evaluate model responses for clinical accuracy, reasoning quality, and appropriate judgment.
  • Identify recurring failure modes in AI reasoning and communicate them clearly to research teams.
  • Collaborate with other psychiatric and clinical experts to maintain consistent evaluation standards.

Screening Process

Qualified candidates will complete a 20–30 minute structured interview.

The screening conversation will focus on your clinical background, independent practice experience, psychiatric specialization, and relevant subspecialty expertise.

Engagement Details

  • Role: Psychiatry Expert
  • Work Arrangement: Fully Remote
  • Engagement Type: Independent Contractor
  • Location Eligibility: US, UK, Europe, or Australia
  • Projects may be extended, shortened, or concluded based on project requirements and performance.
  • Payments are made weekly based on services rendered through available payment platforms.
  • The engagement does not require access to confidential or proprietary information belonging to any current or former employer, client, or institution.
  • H-1B and STEM OPT candidates are not currently supported.

title: Shift Lead
description:
The crew follows your lead. Make it worth following.

As a Shift Lead at Whistle Express, you are the standard-setter on the lot. You know the site, you know the crew, and when management is not on-site, you are the one running it. This is not a babysitting role. It is a leadership role for someone who takes ownership seriously and holds the team to the same standards they hold themselves to.

The work is fast, physical, and visible. At the end of a good shift, you will know it - because the site is clean, the team delivered, and every guest left better than they arrived.

Key Responsibilities:

Customer Engagement

  • Greet customers as they arrive and provide a positive, friendly experience.
  • Answer customer questions about services, wash options, and memberships clearly and courteously.
  • Promote unlimited wash memberships and other offerings to drive engagement and sales.
  • Educate new customers on the variety of wash packages and services available.
  • Observe customer interactions to identify opportunities to enhance service and provide feedback to the team.

Operations & Safety

  • Direct vehicles safely into the wash tunnel, ensuring proper positioning for a smooth process.
  • Prepare vehicles for washing by checking for loose items and removing obstacles as needed.
  • Monitor equipment during operations, identifying and reporting any malfunctions or issues.
  • Follow and enforce all safety protocols to protect customers, team members, and equipment.
  • Assist team members in resolving operational issues quickly to keep the site running efficiently.

Team Leadership

  • Serve as a key holder and perform opening and closing procedures accurately and on time.
  • Lead the team during shifts, providing direction and support in the absence of the Site Leader or Assistant Site Leader.
  • Delegate tasks to team members to ensure smooth site operations throughout the shift.
  • Monitor team performance and provide guidance or feedback as needed to keep operations on track.
  • Handle unexpected challenges or staff issues during the shift, escalating to leadership when necessary.

Attention to Detail

  • Inspect each vehicle before and after the wash to ensure it meets Whistle’s quality standards.
  • Uphold the “Sparkle Assurance” by checking for missed spots, streaks, or any other issues.
  • Report any equipment or operational issues that could affect wash quality.
  • Provide feedback or guidance to team members to help maintain consistent wash quality.
  • Continuously look for ways to improve processes to exceed customer expectations.

#LI-DNI

What We’re Looking For

Ownership is not assigned here. It is demonstrated.

  • You lead by example. The crew watches how you work. Make it worth watching.

  • You hold the line. The standard does not flex based on who is watching.

  • You are a team-first operator. You share the win, and you own the loss.

  • You are physically active and comfortable working outdoors at a pace.

  • Prior leadership or team experience is a plus. The right instincts matter more than the title.

Run it like you own it. Do it like it matters.

The best version of this industry is still being built. The people building it start here.

If you show up like you own it every shift, there is a place here for you.

#LI-DNI

Base Pay Range

If you’re ready to take the wheel and drive performance across a growing territory, we want to hear from you.

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Role Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Java Software Engineer (AI-Driven Development) who is passionate about building high-quality software and leveraging Artificial Intelligence to transform modern software development. This role is ideal for an engineer who not only writes exceptional code but also embraces AI as an essential part of their daily engineering workflow.

The successful candidate will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable enterprise applications while driving the adoption of AI-powered development practices across the engineering team.

Key Functions:

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and integrate with internal and external services.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following modern software engineering best practices.
  • Participate in software architecture discussions and contribute to technical design decisions.
  • Perform code reviews and mentor junior developers where appropriate.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, QA Engineers, DevOps, and Frontend Developers to deliver high-quality software.
  • Develop and execute unit and integration tests to ensure application reliability.
  • Participate in CI/CD processes and support deployment activities.
  • Contribute to frontend development using Angular and TypeScript when required.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve system performance, scalability, and maintainability.

AI-Driven Engineering Responsibilities:

As part of our engineering culture, AI is considered a core capability rather than an occasional productivity tool. The successful candidate is expected to actively leverage AI technologies to:

  • Accelerate software development.
  • Generate, review, and refactor production-quality code.
  • Improve automated testing.
  • Troubleshoot and debug complex technical issues.
  • Analyze large codebases efficiently.
  • Produce technical documentation.
  • Research new technologies and implementation approaches.
  • Improve engineering productivity through AI-assisted workflows.
  • Contribute to the adoption and continuous improvement of AI-enabled development practices across the team.

Core Competencies and Required Background:

  • Minimum 5 years of professional experience in Java software development.
  • Strong proficiency with Java 17+.
  • Extensive experience with Spring Boot.
  • Strong understanding of REST APIs.
  • Experience working with relational databases.
  • Solid knowledge of software architecture and design patterns.
  • Strong understanding of clean code principles and software engineering best practices.
  • Experience with unit and integration testing.
  • Experience using Git, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and modern software development workflows.
  • Practical experience with Angular and TypeScript.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within cross-functional teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with the following will be considered a strong advantage:
  • AI coding assistants such as ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar tools.
  • Open-source or open-weight Large Language Models (LLMs), including Llama, Qwen, Mistral, DeepSeek, or similar.
  • Local AI inference frameworks or model runners such as Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio, or equivalent.
  • Integration of AI into the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Experience implementing AI-enabled engineering workflows and development automation.

Benefits:

  • Competitive Remuneration Package
  • Flexible Work Arrangements (Hybrid Model or remote)
  • Performance-oriented and rewarding company culture.
  • Highly Motivated Environment

Who we are:

At our team, we foster a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and inclusivity. We celebrate diversity and encourage employees to bring their authentic selves to work. Our dynamic and fast-paced environment provides ample opportunities for professional growth and development.

Recruitment Process:

  • CV Review
  • Invitation to online Interview
  • Final Interview
  • Job Offer to successful candidate
